result.stdout:
vox 0.1.3 - Transcribe audio files locally with Whisper.
Usage:
  vox <audio-file> [options]                Transcribe a specific audio file
  vox listen                                Pick a recording from configured sources
  vox latest                                Transcribe the most recent recording
  vox list                                  List recordings, marking transcribed/untranscribed
  vox find <query>                          Find transcripts whose preview matches <query>
  vox find --latest                         Print the path of the most recent transcript

  vox setup                                 First-time interactive setup
  vox config <subcommand>                   Inspect or modify config (vox config --help)
  vox models <subcommand>                   Manage local models (vox models --help)

  vox help                                  Show this help message
  vox <subcommand> --help                   Per-subcommand help
  vox --version                             Print version and exit
  vox --mcp                                 Run as an MCP server over stdio

Options for transcription:
  -o <path>                                 Override the output path
  --model <name>                            Pick a model by name (e.g. small, large-v3)
  --model-path <file>                       Use an explicit ggml model file
  --format txt|srt|vtt|json                 Output format (default: txt)
  --language <code>                         Force a language (default: auto-detect)
  --vad                                     Force Voice Activity Detection on for this run
  --no-vad                                  Force Voice Activity Detection off for this run

Prerequisites:
  whisper-cli (from whisper-cpp) and ffmpeg must both be in PATH.
  Install on macOS:  brew install whisper-cpp ffmpeg

Configuration is stored at ~/.config/voxcli/config.json.
The transcription index is stored at ~/.config/voxcli/index.json.

result.stdout:
vox listen - Pick a recording from configured sources
Usage:
  vox listen [options]                      Pick a recording interactively
  vox listen --latest [options]             Transcribe the most recent recording (same as 'vox latest')

Lists recordings under configured source directories, lets you pick one interactively,
and transcribes the chosen file. Accepts the same flags as 'vox <file>': -o, --model,
--model-path, --format, -l/--language, --vad, --no-vad.

result.stdout:
vox latest - Transcribe the most recent recording
Usage:
  vox latest [options]

Scans configured source directories, picks the most recent audio file by mtime, and
transcribes it. Accepts the same flags as 'vox <file>': -o, --model, --model-path,
--format, -l/--language. If no output directory is configured, you'll be prompted for one.

result.stdout:
vox list - List recordings under configured sources
Usage:
  vox list

Each line is '[T|!| ]  <yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm>  <path>' where:
  [T] - already transcribed (entry present in the index)
  [!] - transcribed but the source file changed afterwards (stale)
  [ ] - not yet transcribed

commands.payload:
vox list - List recordings under configured sources
Usage:
  vox list

Each line is '[T|!| ]  <yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm>  <path>' where:
  [T] - already transcribed (entry present in the index)
  [!] - transcribed but the source file changed afterwards (stale)
  [ ] - not yet transcribed

result.stdout:
vox find - Look up existing transcripts
Usage:
  vox find <query>                          Print transcripts whose preview matches
  vox find --latest                         Print the path of the most recent transcript

Substring matches are case-insensitive against the first ~200 characters of each transcript
(the 'preview' captured at transcribe time). Most-recent matches first, one path per line.

result.stdout:
vox setup - First-time interactive setup
Usage:
  vox setup

Walks through configuring source directories, the output directory, and the default model.
Setup also runs automatically the first time 'vox listen' or 'vox latest' is invoked without an
existing config file. If a configuration already exists it is shown and confirmed before
being overwritten.

result.stdout:
vox config - Inspect or modify the vox configuration
Usage:
  vox config show                           Print the entire configuration as JSON
  vox config sources                        List configured source directories
  vox config output                         Print the configured output directory

  vox config add-source <dir>               Add a source directory
  vox config remove-source <dir>            Remove a source directory
  vox config set-output <dir>               Change the output directory
  vox config set-default-model <name>       Change the default Whisper model
  vox config set-vad on|off                 Enable or disable Voice Activity Detection

Configuration is stored at ~/.config/voxcli/config.json.
